say.en: The organisation chart on the office wall shows who reports to whom. But the news of a bonus often reaches everyone first through the canteen. Both are organisations. In this lesson: Distinguish formal and informal organisation.
State their merits and limitations.

body.en: *Formal organisation* is the structure of authority and responsibility deliberately designed by management. It specifies relationships, follows the scalar chain and rules, and makes it easy to fix responsibility. But it can delay action and ignores social needs.

points.en: Official, written rules and scalar chain
Easy to fix responsibility; may be slow

explanation.en: Formal organisation is the planned structure of authority; informal organisation grows from social interaction inside it.

text.en: Makes it easy to fix responsibility
Can delay action because of procedures
Spreads news fast through the grapevine
May spread rumours and resist change

say.en: Sort each statement: formal organisation or informal organisation.
say.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಅಥವಾ ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

body.en: *Informal organisation* arises from the social interaction of people at work. It has no written rules, spreads information quickly through the grapevine, satisfies social needs and helps fulfil goals. But it may spread rumours, resist change and push members to follow group norms.

points.en: Merits: fast communication, social needs met
Limits: rumours, resistance to change, group pressure

say.en: No fixed channel: grapevine.
Merits: fast communication, social needs met.
Limits: rumours, resistance to change, group pressure.

problem.en: In a Mysuru bank branch, clerks who travel together by the same bus learn about a new scheme before the official circular and help each other learn the new software. Name the type of organisation and two of its benefits.

steps.en: The group arose from travelling together, not from management: informal organisation.
News reached them before the circular: faster spread of communication.
Helping each other with software: helps fulfil organisational goals and social needs.

answer.en: Informal organisation: fast communication and support to organisational goals.
